constraints.name: bending stiffness
constraints.text: must have transverse stiffness in the direction of opposite sense bending such that it does not deflect more than 2 cm under a 5N load if clamped at the root (k >= 5 N / 20 mm = 0.25 N/mm)

constraints.name: buckling
constraints.text: must have buckling strength above 5N under axial compression when under pin/pin boundary conditions

constraints.name: coiling on hub
constraints.text: coils on a 40 mm hub (radius, confirmed by the user)
